expansion: All existing 355 hash-selected one-per-PDS representatives, regardless of new model accuracy. The initial40 are a staging subset, not an independent replication of the355.
assembly_source: Public ENA SEQUENCE_ASSEMBLY records in PRJEB87787 linked by exact canonical BioSample; independently assembled source, not assumed byte-identical to author Pathogenwatch assemblies. Source read-run and method linkage will be retained where available.
source_access: Published ENA HTTPS files, MD5 and byte-count verification; no author contact or authenticated-site bypass.
locked_downstream: Original File11C nucleotide caller/parser AMRFinderPlus 4.2.7 DB2026-08-07.1, model hash1f55620cbd4b1dfd946ff37977e9a851b6aeaad8a5466eb553323331613cdcdd and threshold0.5; original File11E rules unchanged.
QC: Report length, contigs, N50 and ambiguous-base fraction. Flags do not replace selected samples or filter by observed correctness. Unreadable/checksum-failing input prevents scoring and is explicitly reported.
reference: Original published PHAS meropenem S/R with MIC; I/missing unchanged/excluded per original screening.
source_independence_limits: No exact development/E2 BioSample overlap. PDS exclusion concerns only mapped fitting isolates (2944/4218). Add descriptive seen/unseen reported-ST sensitivity without claiming it establishes universal genomic independence.
inference: Report paired model/rule error counts and discrimination. One-per-PDS sampling and source composition limits remain; no clinical-utility or acceptance guarantee.
